test_title: PYST 5: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held on: 26 Oct 2023)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the following sentence.

He is taller and __most__ handsome than his friend.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 2' i.e. more.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence incorrectly uses** "most handsome"** instead of the correct comparative form.
 
• The sentence is making a comparison between two people: "**He**" and** "his friend."**
 
• When comparing two entities, the comparative form of the adjective should be used.
 
• The correct form for "**handsome**" when making a comparison is "more handsome."

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

Correct sentence: *He is taller and more handsome than his friend.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: very more - This is grammatically incorrect. "Very" is used to intensify adjectives but does not combine with "more" in this context.
 
• Option 3: the more - This phrase is used in different contexts, often to indicate a proportional relationship, e.g., "the more you read, the more you learn."
 
• Option 4: the most - This is a superlative form used when comparing more than two entities. It is not suitable for comparing two people.
